title: Abbey Road
description: Abbey Road is the eleventh studio album by English rock band the Beatles, released on 26 September 1969 by Apple Records.

title: Let it be
description: Let It Be is the twelfth and final studio album by the English rock band the Beatles. It was released on 8 May 1978, almost a month after the group's break-up.

title: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
description: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band is the eighth studio album by the English rock band the Beatles.
